justification: A evidência coletivamente sustenta os elementos essenciais da afirmação: (1) não funciona como mandado uniforme de calendário ('It doesn't work as a simple one day less for everyone'); (2) sensibilidade setorial ('In organizations with more than 70 percent knowledge work, pilot data consistently show positive results. Below 50 percent, it becomes difficult'); (3) redesenho de fluxo de trabalho ('They cut meetings, moved communication async, and protected focus time first'; 'It requires active process optimization, meeting reduction, and clear prioritization'); (4) imposição de limites ('protected focus time', 'No-Meeting-Days', 'protected focus blocks'); (5) economia realista de pessoal (discussão sobre custos diretos/indiretos, desafios de cobertura em produção e atendimento ao cliente). O recorte temporal 'through late 2026' é parcialmente sustentado por menções a dados de follow-up de 2 anos publicados em fevereiro de 2026 e 'as of 2026'.
cited_excerpts: It doesn't work as a simple "one day less" for everyone. It requires active process optimization, meeting reduction, and clear prioritization.
The firms that succeeded did not just delete Friday. They cut meetings, moved communication async, and protected focus time first.
In organizations with more than 70 percent knowledge work, pilot data consistently show positive results. Below 50 percent, it becomes difficult without creating fairness problems.
The most successful pilot participants reformed their meeting culture before reducing working hours: meetings from 60 to 30 minutes, asynchronous voting instead of meetings, "No-Meeting-Days".

Production lines require physical presence and cannot be compensated by more efficient meetings. Some models work with shift systems (alternating Monday-Thursday and Tuesday-Friday), others with a 36-hour week instead of 32. The fairness question between office and production is the biggest obstacle in mixed organizations.
Direct costs are manageable: process consulting, workshop moderation, pilot guidance. Indirect costs are higher: reorganization of processes, adjustment of IT systems, training of managers.
The 2-year follow-up (published February 2026) shows: 70 percent of participants continue to work in some reduced form.
No federal policy change is imminent as of 2026.
